Empsephar (Empsephar, S.L. / Empsephar Natura, S.L.) is a Spanish pharmaceutical and parapharmaceutical wholesale distributor based in Elche, Alicante, Spain
. It supplies pharmacies and parapharmacies with health, hygiene, personal care, and beauty product brands, functioning as a logistics and supply chain partner rather than a primary manufacturing plant.
Product Brands Distributed
Empsephar distributes an array of third-party personal care, cosmetics, and pharmacy-channel brands, including:
Rudy Profumi
(Liquid hand soaps like
Sardinian Sun
Sicilian Lemon
Positano Rose
, and
Olive Oil
Nuggela & Sulé
(Hair care and specialized shampoos)
IAP Pharma Parfums
(Pharmacy-exclusive perfumes)
Beter
(Pedicure and manicure accessories)
Esthederm
(Dermatological skincare)
A broad portfolio of general parapharmaceutical, hygiene, and wellness items.
Farmacia Albir
Manufacturer and Partner Network
Empsephar operates primarily as a B2B distributor and logistics intermediary rather than manufacturing its own active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) or proprietary medical drugs.
Its "partners" consist of independent retail pharmacies, regional parapharmacies, and external beauty/health-care product manufacturers whose goods they source and distribute within Spain and neighboring markets.
